notes.title: Version 1.6.0.0
notes.content:
- Polished the look of the game
- Changed some music

notes.title: Big changes in summer maps
notes.content:
- The desert is smaller
- The radiohouse has a better learning curve

notes.title: Fixed inconsistencies found in version 1.5.2.5
notes.content:
- Fixed cacti hitboxes
- Fixed a few textboxes
- Removed objects that blocked certain paths in the spring sector

notes.title: A few small visual inconsistencies were fixed
notes.content:
Here's what's fixed in this version:
- Enemies in battles are centered
- Newton's talksprite doesn't show up in his shop
- A few tiles are updated

notes.title: The Summer sector is now playable from start to finish!
notes.content:
- Improved tiles
- Added new dialogue
- Reworked puzzles
- Improved the Newton boss fight
- Fixed many small bugs
